categories.main_business_segments: Lenovo operates through three main business groups: Intelligent Devices Group (IDG) focusing on PCs, tablets, smartphones, and smart devices; Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) providing servers, storage, edge computing, and AI-optimized infrastructure; and Solutions and Services Group (SSG) delivering IT services, digital workplace solutions, and AI-powered enterprise solutions. These segments collectively cover hardware, software, and services with a strong emphasis on AI integration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Lenovo leverages advanced AI technologies including AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices and infrastructure. The company employs a unique ODM+ model combining in-house manufacturing with outsourced production to enhance cost competitiveness and customization. Key technologies include Neptune liquid cooling solutions for AI servers, hybrid AI infrastructure integrating client devices, edge computing, and hybrid cloud, and proprietary AI agents for personal and enterprise applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lenovo serves a broad customer base including individual consumers, commercial enterprises, cloud service providers, small and medium businesses, and government organizations. Its products and solutions cater to global PC users, smartphone consumers, enterprise IT infrastructure clients, and organizations seeking AI-powered digital transformation. Key markets include healthcare, education, gaming, and smart cities.
categories.geographic_coverage: Lenovo operates globally across 180 markets with significant revenue contributions from China, Asia Pacific (excluding China), Europe-Middle East-Africa (EMEA), and the Americas. The company maintains manufacturing and R&D facilities in China, the US, Europe, and other regions, and has strategic partnerships expanding its footprint in the Middle East and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lenovo operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the technology supply chain, encompassing design, manufacturing, distribution, and after-sales services. Its ODM+ model integrates original design manufacturing with outsourced production, enabling control over product development and supply chain agility. Lenovo also manages a global supply chain network supporting its diverse product portfolio.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on Hybrid AI, integrating public, personal, and enterprise AI to deliver smarter technology solutions. Lenovo invests heavily in R&D, with US$2.3 billion spent in FY2024/25, emphasizing AI innovation in personal computing, enterprise AI infrastructure, and AI-powered services. The company pursues operational excellence, digital transformation, and sustainability, while expanding AI capabilities such as personal super AI agents and enterprise AI twins.
categories.revenue_model: Lenovo generates revenue primarily through product sales of PCs, smartphones, tablets, servers, and related hardware. Additionally, it earns from IT services, software solutions, managed services, and device-as-a-service (DaaS) offerings. Revenue streams also include licensing, extended warranty services, and AI-powered enterprise solutions, with a growing contribution from non-PC products and services accounting for 47% of total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lenovo is the global leader in the PC market with a 23.7% market share and the number one Windows-based AI PC vendor worldwide. It ranks fourth globally in the smartphone market excluding China. The company competes with major technology firms in PCs, smartphones, and enterprise infrastructure, leveraging its hybrid AI strategy and ODM+ manufacturing model to maintain competitive advantages in innovation, cost, and customization.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Lenovo reported US$69.1 billion in revenue for FY2024/25, a 21% year-on-year increase, marking its second highest annual sales. Profit attributable to equity holders rose 37% to US$1.38 billion. The company achieved double-digit growth across all business groups, with ISG growing 63%, SSG 13%, and IDG 13%. Lenovo maintains a strong balance sheet with US$4.8 billion in cash and cash equivalents and a gearing ratio of 0.81.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lenovo emphasizes delivering smarter technology for all through AI-enabled and AI-optimized products and solutions. Its unique ODM+ manufacturing model offers cost competitiveness and customization, while its Hybrid AI Advantage integrates AI across devices, infrastructure, and services to enhance customer effectiveness, security, and sustainability. Lenovo’s commitment to innovation, operational excellence, and global-local business model differentiates it in the competitive technology landscape.
